_meta.description: Curated career roadmap templates. LLM tailors these to the user's profile but cannot invent facts.
_meta.disclaimer: This is guidance based on industry trends. Outcomes depend on your effort, consistency, and opportunities.

roadmaps.subtitle: Beginner path — from zero to job-ready Data Scientist

stages.title: Foundations
stages.checkpoint: Can write a Python script that reads a CSV and computes summary stats

stages.title: Core Skills
stages.checkpoint: Can perform EDA on any dataset and present 5 insights with charts

stages.title: Machine Learning
stages.checkpoint: Can build, evaluate, and explain an end-to-end ML pipeline

stages.title: Projects & Job Prep
stages.checkpoint: Portfolio with 2 deployed projects, resume reviewed, 3 mock interviews done

suggested_projects: House Price Prediction with feature engineering
Customer Churn Analysis with business recommendations

roadmaps.subtitle: Build, deploy, and maintain ML systems in production
prerequisites: Comfort with Git and command line

stages.title: ML Fundamentals Refresh
topics: Feature stores and data versioning concepts
stages.checkpoint: Can build a reproducible ML pipeline with proper train/test split and metrics

stages.title: Production ML
stages.checkpoint: Can containerize and deploy an ML model with an API endpoint

stages.title: MLOps & Scale
topics: Cloud ML services (AWS SageMaker / GCP Vertex AI basics)
stages.checkpoint: Can set up a complete ML pipeline with training, deployment, and monitoring

stages.title: Portfolio & Interviews
stages.checkpoint: 2 production-grade projects on GitHub, system design prep done

suggested_projects: Real-time fraud detection system with model monitoring
Recommendation engine deployed on cloud with A/B testing

roadmaps.subtitle: Master neural networks for Computer Vision and NLP

stages.title: Neural Network Foundations
stages.checkpoint: Can train a simple MLP on MNIST and explain forward/backward pass

stages.title: Computer Vision Track
stages.checkpoint: Can fine-tune a pre-trained model for a custom image classification task

stages.title: NLP Track
stages.checkpoint: Can fine-tune BERT for text classification and explain transformer architecture

stages.title: Research & Portfolio
stages.checkpoint: 2 portfolio projects (1 CV + 1 NLP), one paper replicated

suggested_projects: Plant/Food disease detector with mobile-friendly deployment
Sentiment analysis API using fine-tuned transformer

roadmaps.subtitle: Build production applications powered by Large Language Models

stages.title: LLM Fundamentals
stages.checkpoint: Can build a chatbot using LLM APIs with proper prompt design

stages.title: RAG Pipelines
topics: Text embeddings and vector databases (ChromaDB, Pinecone, Weaviate)
Retrieval pipeline: query → embed → search → generate
stages.checkpoint: Can build a RAG system that answers questions from a document corpus

stages.title: Advanced RAG & Production
stages.checkpoint: Can build a production-ready RAG with guardrails and evaluation metrics

stages.title: Portfolio & Specialization
stages.checkpoint: 2 deployed RAG projects, one with evaluation dashboard

suggested_projects: Document Q&A chatbot with citation and source tracking
Multi-document research assistant with RAG + summarization

roadmaps.subtitle: Build autonomous AI agents that reason, plan, and use tools

stages.title: Agent Foundations
topics: Tool use / function calling with LLMs
stages.checkpoint: Can build a simple agent that uses 2-3 tools to answer questions

stages.title: Multi-Agent Systems
topics: Error handling and retry strategies for agents
stages.checkpoint: Can build a multi-agent system where agents collaborate on a task

stages.title: Production Agents
topics: Guardrails and safety for autonomous agents
stages.checkpoint: Can deploy a production agent with guardrails, logging, and cost tracking

stages.title: Advanced & Portfolio
topics: Custom tool creation (APIs, databases, web scraping)
stages.checkpoint: 2 deployed agent projects, one open-source contribution

suggested_projects: Multi-agent research assistant that finds, summarizes, and compiles reports
Code review agent that analyzes PRs and suggests improvements

roadmaps.subtitle: Build voice-enabled AI assistants and conversational IVR systems

stages.title: Speech Fundamentals
topics: Sarvam AI / Google / Azure speech APIs
stages.checkpoint: Can build a script that converts speech to text and back

stages.title: Conversational Design
stages.checkpoint: Can build a voice-driven FAQ bot with intent routing

stages.title: Production Voicebots
stages.checkpoint: Can deploy a phone-based voicebot that handles real conversations

stages.title: Advanced & Portfolio
stages.checkpoint: 2 deployed voicebot projects, one handling real calls

suggested_projects: Voice-based customer support bot for a restaurant/clinic
Multilingual voice assistant using Sarvam AI + LLM

roadmaps.subtitle: Master the art and science of getting the best results from LLMs
prerequisites: Basic understanding of how AI chatbots work
No coding required to start (Python helpful later)

stages.title: Prompt Basics
topics: How LLMs process prompts (tokens, context windows)
System prompts, role-playing, and persona setting
Common pitfalls and how to debug bad outputs
stages.checkpoint: Can write effective prompts for 5 different use cases

stages.title: Advanced Techniques
stages.checkpoint: Can design prompt pipelines for complex multi-step tasks

stages.title: Applied Prompt Engineering
stages.checkpoint: Can systematically evaluate and optimize prompts with metrics

stages.title: Professional Practice
topics: Staying current with new models and techniques
stages.checkpoint: Portfolio of 5+ prompt solutions across domains, evaluation reports

suggested_projects: Prompt library for automating customer support responses
Evaluation framework comparing prompt strategies across 3 LLMs
roadmaps.honesty_note: Prompt engineering is a valuable skill but is evolving rapidly. It works best combined with technical skills like Python and ML fundamentals.

roadmaps.subtitle: Protect systems, networks, and data from digital threats
roadmaps.honesty_note: We don't currently offer a dedicated cybersecurity course, but our Python+DSA course builds the programming foundation you'll need.

stages.title: Foundations
stages.checkpoint: Can explain common attack vectors and basic network protocols

stages.title: Core Security Skills
stages.checkpoint: Can identify OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities in a sample web app

stages.title: Hands-On Practice
stages.checkpoint: Can complete 10+ CTF challenges and document findings professionally

stages.title: Certification & Career
topics: SOC analyst or pentest interview prep
stages.checkpoint: One certification started, 5 bug bounty reports submitted, interview-ready

suggested_projects: Security audit report for a sample web application
Home lab setup with vulnerable VMs for practice

roadmaps.subtitle: Build, deploy, and manage scalable cloud infrastructure
roadmaps.honesty_note: We don't currently offer a dedicated Cloud/DevOps course, but our Java Backend course covers Docker basics and CI/CD intro.

stages.title: Foundations
stages.checkpoint: Can write Bash scripts and manage a Linux server via SSH

stages.title: Containerization & CI/CD
stages.checkpoint: Can dockerize an app and deploy it via a CI/CD pipeline

stages.title: Cloud Platforms
topics: AWS or Azure core services (EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda)
stages.checkpoint: Can deploy a multi-service app on Kubernetes with monitoring

stages.title: Advanced & Certification
topics: AWS Solutions Architect or Azure equivalent prep
stages.checkpoint: One cloud certification, 2 portfolio projects on GitHub

suggested_projects: Deploy a microservice app on Kubernetes with CI/CD and monitoring
Infrastructure-as-Code setup for a 3-tier web application

roadmaps.subtitle: Build modern websites and mobile applications
roadmaps.honesty_note: We don't currently offer a dedicated web/app development course, but our Java Backend course covers REST APIs, Spring Boot, and Docker basics which are useful for backend web development.

stages.title: Foundations
stages.checkpoint: Can build a static portfolio website with responsive design

stages.title: Frontend Frameworks
stages.checkpoint: Can build a dynamic single-page app that fetches data from an API

stages.title: Backend & Databases
topics: Node.js / Express or Python / Django basics
stages.checkpoint: Can build a full-stack CRUD application with user auth

stages.title: Deployment & Portfolio
stages.checkpoint: 2 deployed full-stack projects, portfolio website live, interview-ready

suggested_projects: Personal portfolio website with blog (React + headless CMS)
Task management app with real-time updates (full-stack)

roadmaps.subtitle: Build decentralized applications and smart contracts
roadmaps.honesty_note: We don't currently offer a blockchain/Web3 course. However, our Python+DSA course builds strong programming fundamentals, and our Java Backend course covers software engineering principles useful for blockchain development.
prerequisites: Proficiency in at least one programming language
Interest in cryptography and distributed systems

stages.title: Blockchain Fundamentals
stages.checkpoint: Can explain blockchain architecture and deploy a test transaction

stages.title: Smart Contract Development
stages.checkpoint: Can write, test, and deploy a basic smart contract on a testnet

stages.title: DApp Development
stages.checkpoint: Can build a full DApp with frontend, smart contract, and wallet integration

stages.title: Advanced & Portfolio
stages.checkpoint: 2 deployed DApps, one security audit report, portfolio with GitHub

suggested_projects: ERC-20 token with a simple DEX interface
NFT marketplace with minting, listing, and buying functionality

intake_questions.question:
What's your current background?
1. Student (school/college)
2. Fresh graduate
3. Working professional
4. Career switcher

What skills do you already have?
1. Complete beginner (no coding)
2. Know basics (Python/Java/any language)
3. Intermediate (built projects)
4. Advanced (working in tech already)

What's your primary goal?
1. Get an internship
2. Land a full-time job
3. Build projects / portfolio
4. Upskill for current role
5. Explore / learn for fun

How many hours per week can you dedicate?
1. Less than 5 hours
2. 5-10 hours
3. 10-20 hours
4. 20+ hours (intensive)
